info.title: Knowledge service public facade through Workspace gateway
info.description: Draft contract; policy/stack decisions remain proposed. Schema validation proves shape only.

post.description: Identity/project/document authority is checked server-side; client fields are selectors, not permission claims. Gateway first allocates identity and commits policy in Workspace, then persists initial Current content in Knowledge under the same actor/operation/key and payload identity. Replays do not duplicate identity, version or grants. No ACL activation. A pending response is an uncertain operation, never document read readiness.

Proposed ADR-0022: current lifecycle authority is independent of read; exactly one numeric revision or opaque delete precondition header is required. Validate/consume atomically with deletion/audit/idempotency. Return 204 with no content. Generic 409 gives no current revision/state. Same-key replay after renewed action checks does not repeat deletion or require a consumed token; unknown commit is reconciled under the original key. A fresh precondition read is not evidence that an earlier write failed.

Proposed ADR-0022: accept exactly one numeric expected_revision already known to the caller or opaque precondition_token from getDocumentCommandPrecondition for this exact action/actor/session/project/document/optional version. Check operation authority and compare private current aggregate revision atomically, consume token on commit with audit/idempotency. Return only DocumentMutationReceipt even if content-read is absent; no content-bearing Version/Document response. Same-key replay rechecks authority and returns original receipt before testing a consumed token; changed payload conflicts. 409 has no current revision/lifecycle/hidden metadata; obtain a fresh precondition and require a fresh user decision. Unknown write outcome uses the same original key/payload until reconciled, never blind fresh-key retry.

get.description: Require current membership and document-read on every page/handoff. Explicit labelled history returns retained available current/superseded/archived version metadata, not content/passages. Order created_at descending then version_id ascending. document_revision is the current Document aggregate revision, used by revise/archive/delete concurrency; never use version identity as revision. getVersion retrieves the selected exact locator; never substitute Current. Deleted/unreadable document gives generic 404; no retention or tombstone browsing entitlement is added. Omit physically unavailable versions without hidden counts. Lifecycle/pointer/retention changes invalidate pagination. Pages are committed, permission-filtered projections ordered as specified. An opaque authenticated cursor binds actor, current membership/permission generation, route, filters, order and the complete visible projection generation. Revalidate authority on every page and protected response handoff. Filter before pagination; expose no hidden counts, placeholders or skipped IDs. Malformed/foreign cursor: generic 400; changed/expired cursor: 409 state_conflict without items. Discard all accumulated pages and restart. No cross-endpoint snapshot is implied. Return Cache-Control: no-store. See Proposed ADR-0019.

post.description: Identity/project/document authority is checked server-side; client fields are selectors, not permission claims. ADR-0013: withheld answers use the fixed AnswerWithheld body; never expose access-change reasons or any part of the original evidence-dependent draft. An invented citation invalidates the original draft; only a new bounded attempt that rechecks claim support, exact citation binding, access and mandatory provenance may be delivered. Otherwise return AnswerWithheld. ADR-0012 v0.3: complete immutable manifest durable outside guard before each provider/answer handoff; guarded exact payload/evidence/revision matching, zero-byte abort on mismatch, fresh preparation only after guard release. Failed/unknown persistence authorises no send; aborted/consumed handoff IDs cannot resume or replay. UI retry guidance: a terminal failure or withheld response has no deliverable original answer; a deliberate new question obtains fresh scope and fresh run/attempt preparation. A lost response is an unknown outcome, never automatic replay/resume of a handoff or automatic fresh-identity resend. An explicitly labelled new user request cannot bypass unresolved transport quarantine. A stale global provider-health badge never permanently disables new requests; actual request outcomes and current session/scope remain authoritative.

get.description: ADR-0013: check current membership and authoritative retained document-read policy under the protected handoff guard. Return exact readable Passage, or verified surviving UnavailableCitation identity without content. Unknown locator or denied identity gets identical generic 404; authority/dependency failure gets 503. Audit-read and prior possession are not read grants. Never substitute a newer version or put unavailable identity into AI context.

FR-58: current membership plus scoped trace-read for this exact run. Source details require separate current source permission; audit-only identity entitlement does not carry over. Permitted-answer-reader status alone does not grant trace access. Unknown/inaccessible runs share generic 404; failed authority denies protected output. Discovery at run scope evaluates this entitlement independently of getRetrievalSummary. Proposed ADR-0021: return the typed inspection projection with actual safely disclosable query/steps, exact permitted document/operational locators and bound visible ranks, explicit validation records and measured/unavailable/not_performed optional metrics. Resolve current authority before projection and protected handoff; omit denied source identities AND dependent query/validation fields without counts or rank gaps. Authority or missing mandatory provenance fails with generic 503, not empty success or a fabricated value. No-store; no private reasoning/raw tool payload/provider error text. Inspection is historical run evidence; source opening separately rechecks exact current access.

Optional FR-27 Should: current membership and current permitted-answer-reader entitlement for the exact run; trace-read is not required and does not itself grant answer-reader entitlement. Recheck current source access and omit denied source details under the existing protected handoff rules. Unknown/unrelated/revoked readers receive generic 404. Authority/dependency failure returns generic 503 without a cached summary. No private reasoning or unrestricted trace fields. Discovery at run scope evaluates this entitlement independently of getTrace. Proposed ADR-0021: return the typed inspection projection with actual safely disclosable query/steps, exact permitted document/operational locators and bound visible ranks, explicit validation records and measured/unavailable/not_performed optional metrics. Resolve current authority before projection and protected handoff; omit denied source identities AND dependent query/validation fields without counts or rank gaps. Authority or missing mandatory provenance fails with generic 503, not empty success or a fabricated value. No-store; no private reasoning/raw tool payload/provider error text. Inspection is historical run evidence; source opening separately rechecks exact current access.

get.description: Require current membership; return only existing nondeleted documents with current authoritative document-read access. Include readable documents with no Current version (current_version_id=null) so archived history remains reachable. Include pending/failed indexing documents; explorer does not depend on embeddings or AI. Minimal metadata only, no excerpts. Order document_id ascending. Optional kind/classification/label filters apply only within authorised results; labels use exact match. Classification is supplied by current Workspace policy, never trusted from an index copy. Workspace authority or Knowledge failure returns 503 without partial data; no empty success on error. Pages are committed, permission-filtered projections ordered as specified. An opaque authenticated cursor binds actor, current membership/permission generation, route, filters, order and the complete visible projection generation. Revalidate authority on every page and protected response handoff. Filter before pagination; expose no hidden counts, placeholders or skipped IDs. Malformed/foreign cursor: generic 400; changed/expired cursor: 409 state_conflict without items. Discard all accumulated pages and restart. No cross-endpoint snapshot is implied. Return Cache-Control: no-store. See Proposed ADR-0019.

get.description: Internal authenticated Workspace-to-Knowledge lookup only. Require service credential plus current actor/session/run/project scope; no browser routing and no reentrant guard. Return only an exact complete durably committed immutable manifest receipt, never raw content. Caller already knows handoff_id; unknown/denied uses generic 404, failed/unknown persistence or authority 503. Lookup and preparation persistence happen outside Workspace guard; final current evidence validation is separate. Manifest receipt grants no read or send authority. No retries or waits under guard.

Current session/project membership plus the exact requested action capability is required, independently of content-read. Only known project/document identities; no listing/history/readiness/content bypass. target_action identifies an implemented existing command; optional metadata editing stays Could and unsupported action is generic 404. archiveVersion additionally requires the supplied exact version_id in this document; all other actions forbid version_id. Missing/extra selectors 400; unknown/denied/mismatched project/document/version 404; authority/storage failure 503 with no cached token. Return only known selector echoes and a fresh opaque token bound in Knowledge to private aggregate revision and current actor/session/policy/action scope. No current revision/state/pointer/grants/content in response. Issuance has no business side effect; no-store. Token possession grants no authority; mutation rechecks current action scope and consumes under local transaction. See Proposed ADR-0022.

registry_state.description: Registered policy or retired policy; active is not proof of Knowledge content availability.

before_ref.description: Protected reference; null when current source-read permission is absent. Audit identity entitlement alone cannot disclose this payload.

after_ref.description: Protected reference; null when current source-read permission is absent. Audit identity entitlement alone cannot disclose this payload.

AuditEvent.description: ADR-0012: current project membership and scoped audit-read permit in-scope actor/action/entity identity/time even without document-read. Protected title/content/before-after references require separate current read authority and are otherwise null/redacted. Audit IDs grant no source/citation/retrieval/AI access; trace-read alone does not inherit this entitlement.

revision.description: Document aggregate revision for lifecycle concurrency; content identity is the document/version locator.

precondition_token.description: Opaque 32-random-byte base64url precondition reference. Binds actor/session/project/document/action/optional version and private current aggregate revision/policy generation; conveys no read or action authority.

Opaque 32-random-byte base64url precondition reference. Binds actor/session/project/document/action/optional version and private current aggregate revision/policy generation; conveys no read or action authority.

semantic_readiness.description: Semantic embedding/index processing of this exact version only. Not permission, Current validity, keyword availability or a guarantee of an eligible retrieval result.

RetrievalSummary.description: Optional FR-27 bounded projection of this run's selected evidence and public step metadata, not candidate inventory, unrestricted tool logs or full trace. Include retrieval and citation_validation steps only. No generation/handoff timings or provider configuration; entitlement is permitted-answer-reader, independently of trace-read.

InternalQuestionResult.description: Internal buffered answer envelope. Exact decoded UTF-8 JSON bytes must parse equal to result and match manifest payload_digest/length. Full evidence and all revisions come from the immutable committed manifest, including uncited and operational context; legacy bare operational IDs/single source revision are forbidden. Workspace resolves committed record, matches actor/session/project/run/attempt/destination, makes one-use durable claim before guard and revalidates complete scope/current evidence through answer handoff. Only frozen result bytes cross the browser boundary; no manifest, receipt or internal envelope is public. Any rejected original draft is withheld as ADR-0013 requires.

PersistDocument.description: Content payload from Workspace after registration; classification and grants remain Workspace-owned. Actor/session comes from authenticated service context, not these fields.

UnavailableCitation.description: ADR-0013: verified surviving exact identity only after current membership and retained document-read policy checks; never source content or generation evidence.

AnswerWithheld.description: ADR-0013: no source, citation, run ID, generated text or detailed cause. Full evidence-set withholding; inspect causes only through authorised trace access.

missing_components.description: Requested components that lack evidence; use only request-visible terms. Never reveal hidden source identity, grant or existence.

PartiallyAnswered.description: ADR-0015: supported cited components plus explicit missing requested components. Every claim must pass support and current-access checks. Never salvage an invalid or revoked original draft by truncation.

version_digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over the exact specified bytes; no normalization or JSON reserialization.

excerpt_digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over the exact specified bytes; no normalization or JSON reserialization.

entity_digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over the exact specified bytes; no normalization or JSON reserialization.

payload_digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over the exact specified bytes; no normalization or JSON reserialization.

manifest_digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over the exact specified bytes; no normalization or JSON reserialization.

StoredHandoff.description: Knowledge-owned immutable committed manifest receipt. Decode manifest_bytes_base64 as UTF-8 JSON equal to manifest; manifest_digest hashes those exact bytes. Resolve by authenticated getHandoffManifest and compare the entire stored record before claiming. A caller assertion, digest or complete=true is never evidence of persistence or current access.

InspectionQuery.description: The actual recorded query, not a model-generated explanation. unavailable means current disclosure rules withhold query text; missing mandatory query persistence is an error, not an optional metric gap. not_performed only when the step never ran.

DurationMetric.description: Measured zero is valid. Missing/failed optional timing is unavailable without a numeric value; an unexecuted activity is not_performed. Never fabricate zero.

TokenUsageMetric.description: Recorded total token count for this run/step only. Missing/partial provider usage is unavailable, not a guessed sum; no token count for an unexecuted activity.

InspectionStep.description: Recorded permitted step metadata only; no tool arguments/results, source text, provider reasoning, secrets or raw errors. Repeated attempts have distinct step_id. Dense display_order is assigned after current disclosure filtering. Non-query stages use query.not_performed.

InspectionSource.description: Exact currently permitted source locator; rank is dense within the visible selected sources of step_id, preserving recorded relative order. No raw scores, denied source IDs, skipped ranks, hidden totals or omitted-source markers. Operational observations are historical evidence, not an assertion of current work state.

InspectionValidation.description: Source-bound entries require a currently permitted ranked source mapping; omit the entire entry when its identity is denied. Null source_id is only for a safely disclosed run-level result, never a placeholder for a hidden/invalid source. Claim support is separately evaluated; locator success does not prove it.

precondition_token.description: Opaque 32-random-byte base64url precondition reference. Binds actor/session/project/document/action/optional version and private current aggregate revision/policy generation; conveys no read or action authority.

DocumentCommandPrecondition.description: Action-authorised minimal precondition projection, independent of content-read. Echo only supplied identities/action and an opaque token; no current revision, lifecycle state, pointer, labels, owner or content.

DocumentMutationReceipt.description: Committed command acknowledgement, not a content read or current state. For revise, version_id is only the new identity created by this command; for archive, only the supplied exact target identity; metadata edit uses null. No existing title/content/owner/labels/state/current pointer/revision. Persist atomically with command/audit/idempotency receipt; replay returns the original receipt after renewed operation authority.

NotFound.description: Unknown or inaccessible resource; identical public body

Unavailable.description: Dependency/permission check unavailable; protected output denied

QuestionUnavailable.description: Explicit dependency failure or nondisclosing terminal withholding. No generated answer.
